channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Vivian Dsena Leaves ‘Laughter Chefs’; Mystery Colors Show in the Works
item.description: Actor Vivian Dsena has exited the reality show ‘Laughter Chefs: Fun Unlimited 3’, as he is set to begin work on a new fiction series, which remains under wraps, “but those close to it hint at a familiar universe returning in a new form.”

item.title: Three killed as bus collides with car in Karnataka
item.description: According to police, the tragedy occurred following a head-on collision between a car and a Road Transport Corporation (RTC) bus. All the victims were car occupants.

item.title: Harmanpreet Crosses 1,000 WPL Runs as MI Register Big Win
item.description: Mumbai Indians skipper Harmanpreet Kaur praised youngsters for taking responsibility after the two-time champions thrashed Gujarat Giants by seven wickets at the DY Patil Stadium in Navi Mumbai on Tuesday.

item.title: 88 tonnes of e-waste collected during special drive in Hyderabad
item.description: On the first day, the drive was conducted in 271 locations across GHMC. Officials stated that 95 vehicles were utilised for e-waste collection, and 47 tonnes of e-waste were collected.

item.title: Raveena Tandon and Daughter Rasha Thadani Shoot Together, Share Fun Gupshup Moments
item.description: Bollywood's beloved mother and daughter duo, Raveena Tandon and Rasha Thadani, are often seen spending time together, from posing for the shutterbugs to going on a spiritual spree.

item.title: Telangana RTC to operate 3,495 special buses for Medaram Jatara
item.description: The Telangana State Road Transport Corporation (TSRTC) on Tuesday announced that it will operate 3,495 special buses for the upcoming Sammakka-Sarakka Maha Jatara.

item.title: DK Shivakumar’s Post Sparks Fresh Talk of Karnataka CM Change
item.description: The leadership tussle in Karnataka has once again come to the forefront, with Deputy Chief Minister and state Congress President D.K. Shivakumar, a strong contender for the CM post, sharing a cryptic poster on Wednesday.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open lower over FII outflows, crude prices rise
item.description: ONGC, Coal India and NTPC were among major gainers on the Nifty. Sectoral indices were trading mixed with the majority of them in the red. Nifty metal as well as oil and gas were among the major gainers, up 0.84 per cent and 0.32 per cent.

item.title: Rani Mukerji flies kites in Gujarat: Thrilled to see the love for ‘Mardaani’ here
item.description: Actress Rani Mukerji, who is all geared up for the release of her “Mardaani 3”, was seen flying kites on the occasion of Makar Sankranti in Gujarat and was thrilled to see the love pouring in for her upcoming film.

item.title: Hyundai Motor aims to develop India into a ‘strategic export hub’
item.description: The head of South Korea's automotive giant Hyundai Motor Group has visited three key overseas markets -- China, the United States and India -- at the start of the new year as part of the group's global expansion strategy, the company said on Wednesday.
